Body.Content:
What if scenario modeling enables you to simulate changes to a project plan and evaluate their impact before committing to them. Available for both Project Operations core and Project Operations connect with ERP deployment types, this capability can be enabled through Feature Control and allows you to: - Create and manage multiple versions of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). - Modify key planning variables, including schedule, scope, effort, and resources. - Analyze the impact of changes across one or more planning variables in real time. - Compare alternative scenarios, identify the optimal plan, and apply selected changes to the original project plan.

GA date: July CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
